description: The SQL is the call (https://www.tinybird.co/docs/api-reference/query-api): GET /v0/sql takes it as `q` ("The SQL query"), and POST /v0/sql takes it in the body — the reference's examples send `{"q": "...", <template params>}` as application/json. The POST table omits `q` because it lives in the body. Template parameters beside `q` are caller-chosen names and travel as extra JSON keys. Live: GET /v0/sql?q=SELECT 1 ... FORMAT CSVWithNames 200 text/csv; POST /v0/sql {"q": "SELECT count() ... FORMAT JSON"} 200 application/json.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The SQL query, templated or not. Template parameters go beside it as extra keys.
